dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a busy morning. We can keep our discussion focused. Before we discuss the account, may I have your identification details for verification?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. I have your account open. There is no need to search through the business paperwork for this conversation.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That pile can wait lah. I've put the office files aside and got my personal notes here. The holding I want to transact in is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend selling Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hmm. Let me refer to what I've written here. At least this page easy to find, not mixed up with the office documents. For this transaction, use renminbi, please. The transaction amount, put 250,000. Quantity is 2,000 units. Use a market order for this, please.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Before we finish, would you like me to note a preference for arranging future telephone appointments?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Late morning usually easier for me. Early morning, the staff all come looking for decisions, then the phone keeps ringing. Don't just call without arranging, can? Send me a message first and let me reply when I've checked my diary. Sometimes I'm out visiting customers.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that preference. We can arrange a mutually convenient appointment rather than assume you are available. Would you prefer appointment messages to remain brief?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Brief is good. Just say it's about arranging a call and I'll get back to you. No need to put account matters in the message. My assistant helps with the office diary, but my personal appointments I handle myself.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I will note that you prefer to handle these appointments directly and keep scheduling messages limited to arranging the call. You can let me know if that preference changes.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Good, that saves the messages going round the office. Today quite smooth actually, once I found the right notes. Now I can get back to clearing the desk before everyone comes back from their meetings.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for making time, Adrian. I'll leave you to your work. If you need to rearrange a future appointment, please contact me through the usual bank channel. Have a good afternoon.
